problem: E10's currency check was a one-off, manually-written comparison specific to that phase -- not a reusable mechanism other phases (or future automated cycles) could call.

decision.decision_summary: Generalize it into currencyGuard(), a real, typed function comparing indexed vs. real experience_ids, connected as the concrete backing for the locked Pre-Execution Procedure's step 3.

action.action_summary: Implemented currencyGuard() + generateIndexRefreshCandidate() (reusing buildIndex() verbatim), and connected them to the E10 procedure.

evidence.evidence_source: This phase's own real currencyGuard() runs (see [1] and [5])
evidence.evidence_detail: Guard correctly reported CURRENT before this experience existed, and (see [4]/[5]) correctly reports STALE once this real experience exists but is not yet indexed.

result.note: Improves the Experience Layer's own self-consistency mechanism; does not change this Goal's own real status.

cause.root_cause_summary: Currency-checking existed only as inline, phase-specific code (E9, E10) -- not yet a named, reusable, independently-callable mechanism.

lesson: The very act of recording this improvement as a new Experience immediately and honestly makes the prior Index stale by exactly one -- this is not a bug to work around, it is the real, expected dynamic the Currency Guard exists to detect every time, without needing an artificial demonstration.
